dct_description_sm: 2 bar scales on map, given in “Milliarium Germanicor” and “Leucarum Hispanicaru.”
Latitudinal and longitudinal lines along margins.
Shows the Kingdom of Prester John, mythical Christian king.
Includes islands off the Horn of Africa.
Inset map: Congi Regni in Africa Christiani: Nova descriptio.
This copy has pencil inscription in lower left: 63.
"326" and "327" on verso, and Latin text.
